mentions.name: Cloud-independent recipe app
mentions.description: A recipe app built to operate independently of AWS and Cloudflare, so it remains usable when major cloud services go down. Launch is planned for 2026.
mentions.problem: Apps that depend on major cloud providers become unavailable during outages; this recipe app is designed to keep working so users can still cook.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A recipe app that is not dependent on AWS or Cloudflare. When everything else goes down, at least you can cook :)

Launch is planned in 2026.
